# Anton Egorov — AI Creative Technologist

> I turn AI generation into scalable production.

- Portfolio: https://eyeanton.github.io/
- CV (PDF): https://eyeanton.github.io/assets/cv-en.pdf

## What I do

- **AI generation** — Video, imagery and sound for products — from prompt to finished file. Tools: ComfyUI, Nano Banana, Flux, Midjourney, Recraft, Kling, ElevenLabs, Suno.
- **Automation** — Pipelines that turn generation into scalable product. Tools: Google Cloud Run, Gemini API, Make, Claude, Cursor, ffmpeg, Python, Node.js.
- **Motion & 3D** — Modelling, texturing, optimization and animation. Tools: After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender, Marvelous Designer, Substance Painter.
- **Design** — Professional using of the basic design tools. Tools: Figma, Photoshop.

Soft skills: Bridging creative & tech, Process audit & automation, Rapid prototyping, AI tool evaluation, Explaining AI to non-tech teams, Cross-functional collaboration.

## My projects

- [Virtual Gifts](https://eyeanton.github.io/project.html?id=virtual-gifts) (2026, Design) — A collection of animated virtual gifts for a dating app: from the idea to a full-screen animation with sound. Tags: AI 3D, Motion, Art direction, VP9 alpha.
- [Visual Novels](https://eyeanton.github.io/project.html?id=emotions-club) (2025, AI & bots) — Interactive visual novels for two players: an agent writes one JSON per story, one ComfyUI flow makes backgrounds, characters with emotions, covers and video covers in one style. 29 novels. Tags: ComfyUI, AI pipeline, Characters, Art direction.
- **Sticker generator** (2026, AI & bots) — A Telegram bot that turns photos into stickers and stylised portraits through RunningHub AI pipelines. Tags: Python, aiogram, ComfyUI, Docker.
- [Stasik](https://eyeanton.github.io/stasik-page/) (2026, Hardware) — Firmware for M5Stack (ESP32): a health counter with screen, buttons and sound, over-the-air updates. Plus an Android app that works as its remote. Tags: C++, PlatformIO, M5Unified, Android.

## Stack & tools

ComfyUI, Flux, Midjourney, Nano Banana, Kling, Recraft, ElevenLabs, Suno, Gemini API, Claude, Cursor, Make, Replicate, Blender, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Marvelous Designer, Substance Painter, Figma, Photoshop, ffmpeg, Python, Node.js, Google Cloud Run.

### Senior CG Artist — Social Discovery Group (Jan 2025 — Oct 2026)
- Automated video-gift pipeline: Kling API + Gemini + ffmpeg, chroma key, webm/hevc export (Node.js)
- Photo-to-sticker pipeline: Make + Google Cloud Run + Gemini API
- Visual-novel generation on RunningHub: scripts, characters and illustrations, fully automated
- 3D motion: gifts, icons, onboarding animations; motion workflow from storyboard to revisions

### Freelance (Nov 2022 — Mar 2024)

### 3D Modeller — Comme Des Creators (May 2020 — Nov 2022)

- OpenGL-based renders: modelling, texturing, asset integration
